title: upstream: draft object-history stopgap messages/issues (decision 6)
description:
Design: docs/design/object-history.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: H22. Crates: none. Size: S.

Decision 6: implement the stopgaps now, raise them upstream, and offer Mark drafted list messages or issues. Source: the 'Upstream list' in docs/design/DECISIONS.md. Design: docs/design/object-history.md §2 rows for §3, §4, §5.1, and §9 conditional.

Draft, for Mark to send, text for the object-history author (brong/draft-gondwana-jmap-object-history, or the jmap list):
(a) RFC 8620 maxObjectsInSet names only create/update/destroy; propose that restore entries count toward it.
(c) -03 adds no Foo/queryChanges arguments; propose a sentence that an onlyDestroyed query is identified by its queryState (the server encodes the kind).
(d) A destroyed object whose final version was discarded while older versions remain: propose that it is gone (notFound for get, query and restore), not represented by an older version.

For BOTH the object-history and conditional authors:
(b) conditional §4 atomic covers 'every creation, update, and destroy' and atomicFailure names only notCreated/notUpdated/notDestroyed. Propose that atomic covers restores and atomicFailure MAY carry notRestored.

Cite -03 section numbers and quote the spec text. Do not send anything.

Acceptance: the drafted text is handed to Mark, and the item is marked as offered in the upstream list.
